title: FLOOR BACKPACK CARDS ON A PAD
why: The o-10 pictures: on a pad the Undercroft backpack showed two item cards over its own edges (the focused cell card covered view to close, a belt card covered the details and the footer hint), and the keyboard chip sat on the location title. The card was placed by a guessed width; it is now placed by its real size beside the panel, the belt hover card is off while a pad drives, and the chip sits top centre in the Undercroft.
now: One item card beside the open floor backpack, clear of its header and hint row; the keyboard chip clear of the title.
